name: HVE Core Adoption Advisor
description: Adopt Microsoft's HVE Core (Hyper Velocity Engineering) for GitHub Copilot: explain what it is, choose the install method, match a need to the right agent or skill, run a task through Research-Plan-Implement-Review, plan a team rollout, and audit a repository's Copilot customizations against HVE Core conventions.
author: Arindam Choudhury
